title: manager setup · Assign planner to define a bounded research task for descriptive bench
summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research task for descriptive benchmark metrics on agent memory, explicitly noting missing controlled baselines.
body: Previous cycles failed to find 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets. Claims of superiority are unsupported. Pivot to gathering descriptive evidence (success/hallucination rates) on standard benchmarks (ScienceWorld, BigBench) under fixed budgets. If <4 sources match strict criteria, expand to 'resource usage' but strictly flag the absence of A/B testing. Limit to 4 sources; no code execution.
